scientific_integrity: The finite factor classification is certified by a self-contained exhaustive checker and a four-block completeness argument; the infinite lower bound relies on Campbell–Rampersad Theorem 6. No independent audit or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only binary Thue–Morse, exactly two tortoise steps, and maximum fiber sizes; no claim about full two-step class counts or other automatic words.
title: Exact maximal two-tortoise fiber spectrum of Thue–Morse factors
